title: Spirekeeper
kicker: a sleepless keeper of relay mechanisms, bell chains, and failing signal lights
hook: a sleepless keeper of relay mechanisms, bell chains, and failing signal lights

blocks.label: Public Read
blocks.body: A narrow, sleepless keeper in dark maintenance robes stands among hanging bells and relay chains, blue glass pendant at her chest and a keyring tucked into both hands.

blocks.label: Comes Across As
blocks.body: Sleepless devotion to a fragile chain of care strung between far places. Ties a knot in a cord for every missed reply. Her worst fear is being the last person who knows a call went unanswered.

blocks.label: Might Offer
blocks.body: A human face for failing infrastructure A clue about missed relay signals A reason to care before the next adventure starts
